messages.subject: Postdoctoral opportunity in Bayesian hierarchical modelling
parts:
Dear colleagues,

I would again like to advertise a postdoctoral opportunity on behalf of Prof. Antonio Hernández-Matías, from the University of Barcelona. Please see the attached document.

The opportunity is to apply for a funded position in his lab using the Juan de la Cierva funding programme from the Spanish government. The applicant should have a completed PhD within the last two years. 

To express interest or for further information, please contact Antonio directly (email address in the attachment).

Best,

Jaume
